overview.text: The Cloudy Snail-eating Snake is a small, slender, harmless tree snake of southern Mexico, Central America and northern South America that eats snails.

identification.text: Grey to brown with irregular dark ring-like bands edged with small beige spots; white to beige belly with tiny dark dots.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Southern Mexico through Central America to Colombia, Venezuela, the Guianas, Ecuador and north-eastern Brazil, plus Trinidad and Tobago.
